series.maturityRule: 31 December of the 30th calendar year after year of issue (per text printed on forms; Poste table rows 21-30)
series.capitalization: Years 1-20: interest accrues per completed bimester (simple interest within the year) and is capitalized annually (compound) NET of withholding tax (DM 23/06/1997 art.7 c.3 for Q/R/S issued up to 31/12/1996). Years 21-30: simple interest (no capitalization), accrued per completed bimester, until 31 December of the 30th calendar year after the year of issue. No interest if redeemed before 12 months.
series.notes: Instituted by DM Tesoro 13/06/1986 (art.4) from 01/07/1986; rates 8/9/10.5/12% by 5-year bracket. Q buoni issued from 01/11/1995 were re-classed as series R (stamped 'R/Q'), so Q buoni issued in 1994-1995 (up to 31/10/1995) carry Q rates with 12.5% withholding. Years 21-30: Poste table shows 12% simple; ABF decisions describe it as a fixed bimonthly amount = 12% simple interest computed on the capital reached at year 20 (Poste's position). The rates TABLE of the DM 1986 is 'omissis' in the copy I could read, so the exact base for years 21-30 (montante at year 20, net) is inferred from ABF decisions, not from the decree text. The original Q forms printed the per-bimester amounts in lire on the back; for real Q forms those printed figures are what Poste pays.

series.capitalization: Years 1-20: interest accrues per completed bimester (simple interest within the year) and is capitalized annually (compound) NET of withholding tax (DM 23/06/1997 art.7 c.3 for Q/R/S issued up to 31/12/1996). Years 21-30: simple interest (no capitalization), accrued per completed bimester, until 31 December of the 30th calendar year after the year of issue. No interest if redeemed before 12 months.
series.notes: DM Tesoro 13/10/1995 (GU 31/10/1995 n.255) art.5, effective 01/11/1995. Table: years 1-20 'con capitalizzazione annuale', years 21-30 11.5% 'senza capitalizzazione annuale'. Q forms issued from 01/11/1995 = series R (stamped R/Q). R forms issued from 01/12/1996 are series S (DM 27/11/1996 art.2).

series.capitalization: Years 1-20: interest accrues per completed bimester (simple interest within the year) and is capitalized annually (compound) NET of withholding tax (DM 23/06/1997 art.7 c.3 for Q/R/S issued up to 31/12/1996). Years 21-30: simple interest (no capitalization), accrued per completed bimester, until 31 December of the 30th calendar year after the year of issue. No interest if redeemed before 12 months. Note: for S issued from 01/01/1997, DM 23/06/1997 art.7 says capitalization is net of substitute tax for art.2 D.Lgs 239/96 holders (individuals) and gross for other holders.
series.notes: DM Tesoro 27/11/1996 (GU 30/11/1996 n.281), effective 01/12/1996. Annual capitalization 'al netto della ritenuta fiscale del 12,50%'. From year 21 to the 30th calendar year after issue: 0.50% simple interest (base not stated in decree; presumably montante at year 20). Placement ended on publication of DM 23/06/1997 (GU 24/06/1997).

series.capitalization: Years 1-20: bimonthly accrual, annual compounding. The decree's table note says capitalization 'al netto dell'imposta sostitutiva del 12,50%'; art.7 c.1 says T is capitalized GROSS for holders NOT in art.2 D.Lgs 239/96 (i.e. non-individuals). For individuals the table note (net) is the only indication. Years 21-30: 0.50% simple interest until 31/12 of 30th calendar year after issue.
series.notes: DM Tesoro 23/06/1997 (GU 24/06/1997 n.145) art.6, effective 01/07/1997. Net vs gross capitalization for individuals: treat as NET (table note), but this is ambiguous.

series.capitalization: Years 1-20: bimonthly accrual, annual compounding; years 21-30: 0.50% simple interest. Whether capitalization is gross or net of the 12.5% tax is NOT confirmed (instituting decree not found).
series.notes: Rates and dates only from the Poste summary table (edition Sept 2017). The instituting DM (late 1997) was not located on cdp.it. Successor series V (from 10/12/1998) is capitalized gross, so U is probably gross too, but unverified.

formulaVerified: coef(months) = prod_{y<floor(months/12)} (1+r_y) * (1 + r_next * floor((months mod 12)/2)/6); 0 interest if months<12. Reproduces official Tabella B coefficients to 8 decimals for B5 (12,14,16,24,26,120,240 months), B98, B13, A8 and the 20-year coefficient of every B series listed. For 30-year series Q-X, same structure in years 1-20 (per Poste table footnote), then simple interest in years 21-30.

tax.appliedAt: Redemption for series capitalized gross (V, W, X, A*, B*): tax = 12.5% x (gross value - face). For Q, R, S (issued up to 31/12/1996) the tax is deducted at each annual capitalization (net compounding), DM 23/06/1997 art.7. Q issued 01/07/1986-20/09/1986 exempt; 21/09/1986-31/08/1987 6.25%.

stampDuty.rule: Imposta di bollo 0.20% per year on value (from 2014; 0.10% 2012, 0.15% 2013), only if total redemption value of the holder's buoni exceeds EUR 5,000; accrued and withheld at redemption. In early redemption it cannot bring the net below the nominal (excess refunded per FI).
stampDuty.caveats: Rate and threshold confirmed on Poste FAQ and recent FI; the annual-rate history and the special treatment of paper buoni issued before 2009 come from secondary sources (quifinanza) and are unverified.

maturityAndPrescription.afterMaturity: Buono becomes non-interest-bearing from the day after natural maturity (Poste FAQ: 'diventa infruttifero dal giorno successivo alla scadenza naturale'). B-series FI: no interest after the 20th anniversary.
maturityAndPrescription.maturity30y: Q..Z (issued up to 27/12/2000): interest until 31 December of the 30th calendar year after the year of issue.
maturityAndPrescription.maturity20y: A1 onward (from 28/12/2000): 20 years from subscription date.
maturityAndPrescription.prescriptionRule: Rights to capital and interest lapse 10 years after the maturity date (DM 19/12/2000 art.8; DM 06/10/2004 art.6-ter; FI art.10). Applies to paper buoni; dematerialized buoni are credited automatically at maturity. Prescribed buoni issued 1953-13/04/2001 go to MEF; from 14/04/2001 to the fund under L.266/2005. No refund after prescription.
maturityAndPrescription.examples: Series R issued 1996 -> matures 31/12/2026 -> prescribes 31/12/2036 (Poste notice lists R (1996), T (1997), B15-B38 as expiring). B1 (2004) -> matures 2024 -> prescribes 2034.

lireConversion.rounding: NOT confirmed from an official buoni source. Recommended: compute in full precision (lire face / 1936.27 x coefficient) and round final euro amount to the cent; Poste figures may differ by small amounts. Euro-changeover rules (Reg. CE 1103/97) round to nearest cent.

stampedRatesOverride: DM 13/06/1986 art.5: series P forms issued from 01/07/1986 count as series Q, stamped 'Q/P' on front with new rates on back (rates 1-20). Where the stamp did not cover years 21-30, ABF/courts (Cass. SU 13979/2007) apply the amounts printed on the original P form for years 21-30, net of tax; for genuine Q forms no override (ABF Coord. 6142/2020; Cass. SU 3963/2019 confirms DM can modify rates). Same mechanism: Q forms issued from 01/11/1995 = R ('R/Q'); R forms from 01/12/1996 = S; and every later decree reclassifies old-series forms issued after its effective date. The calculator should key off the effective series by issue date, with an override flag for Q/P.
posteApi: Not observed. Direct HTTP access to buonielibretti.poste.it, cdp.it and media.poste.it was blocked by this environment's egress proxy, so raw page source/JS could not be inspected. The text-extracted page at https://buonielibretti.poste.it/risparmiare-con-i-buoni shows only the heading 'Calcola il valore del tuo Buono' and no script, API, JSON or iframe URLs. CDP's calculator page (calcolo-rendimenti-buoni) says a new simulator is coming and links to poste.it. No public documented API found. Recommendation: use the extracted formula; to look for an XHR endpoint, open DevTools Network tab on the Poste page in a browser.
openQuestions: Series U: instituting decree not found; whether capitalization is gross or net of tax is unverified (rates from Poste table only).
Series T for individuals: decree table says net capitalization, art.7 c.1 says gross for non-art.2 holders; individuals treatment inferred as net.

Years 21-30 for Q/R/S..X: base for simple interest assumed = value at end of year 20 (net for Q/R/S); decrees do not state it explicitly; ABF decisions describe Q as fixed bimonthly amount at 12% on year-20 capital.
Q years 21-30: Poste table shows 12%; original lire forms printed specific per-bimester amounts which govern for the paper buono.
Exact rounding used by Poste at redemption (per-step vs final; lire vs euro) is unconfirmed.
